description: ROC watches BAS and access control alarms for state and county sites and dispatches technicians
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Freeze, flood, and server-room temperature alarms need action within hours; door-forced and door-held alarms are security events; after 8 hours the county and state must staff buildings themselves
manual_workaround: Site Managers and on-call technicians walk sites on a schedule; customers' own security staff watch door alarms locally
dependent_third_parties: Access control SaaS vendor; cloud provider; ISPs
dependent_people_or_facilities: ROC operators; on-call technicians; ROC office

description: Issue and revoke badges, change door schedules, grant event access for state and county cardholders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A terminated county or state employee's badge must be revoked promptly; controllers cache credentials for 72 hours so doors keep working but changes stop; cardholder data changes must not be lost
manual_workaround: Customer security staff hold a printed emergency revoke list and can lock doors locally at the controller
dependent_people_or_facilities: Security Systems Supervisor; 2 security systems technicians

description: Scheduling, setpoints, trends, and alarm routing for about 1,150 BACnet controllers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Controllers keep their last programs and schedules, so buildings stay comfortable for about a day; summer heat and schedule changes for events make longer outages visible; trend data older than a day has low value
manual_workaround: Technicians change schedules at controllers or engineering workstations on site; manual-mode procedures (to be written for CT-S and CT-C)
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider; ISPs; BAS software vendor

description: O&M of the GSA building, including BAS operation on GSA systems through GSA virtual desktop
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: GSA contract performance standards; building recovery procedures (tested March 2026) keep the BAS running locally; loss of PIV-credentialed staff or GSA access stops remote BAS work
manual_workaround: BTTRG building recovery procedures: local operation at controllers; work orders on paper

business_process: Work order and preventive maintenance management
description: Create, dispatch, and close work orders and preventive maintenance for all three contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Work continues from printed schedules for a few days; contract reports need complete work order history
manual_workaround: Paper work orders and a shared spreadsheet; enter later

description: Keep cameras and NVRs running; export video for county and state investigations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: NVRs record locally, so recording continues; exports can wait a few days unless police request them
manual_workaround: Export directly at the NVR on site

description: Program, back up, and restore BAS controller logic and graphics
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Needed to recover a failed or tampered controller; today programs sit only on laptops so the real RPO is unknown (R-007)
manual_workaround: Vendor commissioning files for 2 sites; reprogram from drawings (slow)

description: Monthly deliverables, performance reports, and invoices to GSA, the state, and the county
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly cycle; about $2.35 million invoiced per month; late invoices delay cash but are not lost
manual_workaround: Invoice from accounting records; send reports late with notice

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, terminations, PIV and background check coordination
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; termination steps (badge and PIV return, account disable) must still happen same day
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll; paper termination checklist
